scope: Direct model-forward and TargetKVCache.crop instrumentation on HumanEval/114; diagnostic only, no timing claim.
limits: This verifies active canonical prefixes and crop lengths; backing-buffer bytes beyond the logical length are not zeroed or treated as valid KV.
Rejected suffix tensors are not individually compared against a separately materialized temporary cache; the implementation writes in-place and then crops logical lengths.
Hooked diagnostic timing is excluded from performance claims.
